state.objective: Configure PodDisruptionBudget for critical search-indexing cluster.

context.content: Search index cluster requires minimum 3 out of 5 quorum replicas alive to process queries without read degradation.
Deployment replicas: 5; node upgrades drain 1 node at a time.
Image: elasticsearch:8.11.2 with custom synonyms plugin.

submitted_answer.answer: Configure a PodDisruptionBudget requiring at least 3 replicas to remain available.
